description: The history of a dynamic DNS record, newest first (the newest 50 are kept)

kind.description: What happened: the value `changed`, the record was `created`, the record `failed` or `recovered`

ip_version.description: `ipv4` or `ipv6` for an address change; null for an alias or a state change

old_ip.description: The value before the change (an address, or a CNAME target for an alias)

new_ip.description: The value after the change (an address, or a CNAME target for an alias)

message.description: The error message of a `failed` entry, with every secret replaced by ***
